cover_letter:
Dear TransPerfect Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the freelance SEO Specialist role supporting global brands expanding into the Belgian Dutch market. Your project list—technical SEO audits, LLM visibility, Core Web Vitals, hreflang and content strategy—reflects the mix of technical and editorial work I do every day.

As a freelance SEO and WordPress specialist, I build and optimise websites for both traditional and AI-powered search. For mirook.com, a site for a Belgian youth chess champion, I implemented JSON-LD schema (Person, SportsEvent, FAQPage), knowledge-graph markup and an llms.txt file, and ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. That project combined exactly the kind of structured data, AI-search visibility and technical review work your audits call for.

Alongside freelancing, I work as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, handling on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites, and tracking results with Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Google Search Console. I publish and maintain content in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math) and manage Shopify catalogues and blogs. I use LLMs daily for research, content and audits, and apply prompt engineering and Python automation to make repetitive SEO work faster and more consistent.

My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and applied computer science gives me a solid grasp of the technical side of crawling, rendering and Core Web Vitals. I'm comfortable working project-based and remotely, and I communicate clearly in English.

One point to be transparent about: my Dutch is currently B1 in writing and A2+ in speaking, and I'm actively improving it. I understand the role calls for native Belgian Dutch, so I'd welcome the chance to discuss how my SEO and AI-search experience could still support your team, perhaps on English-language or technical workstreams while my Dutch develops.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
